name: expense-webapp
description: The Employee and Manager web app: submitting expense claims with receipt photos (auto-extracted via receipt-agent), tracking and editing/withdrawing pending claims, claim history, the Manager's approval queue, and a chat screen where a Manager sets the team's weekly limit in plain language via limit-agent, with that limit shown to Employees while they submit a claim. Holds no business data itself — everything is read/written through expense-api, receipt-agent and limit-agent.
